course.name: Building with FlowPilot
course.description: Ask FlowPilot for a scoped edit, review it, and verify a repair.
course.longDescription: Prerequisite: Welcome to Flow-Like and a Simple Event → Print Info practice Flow. Use Desktop or web with a configured FlowPilot model; external CLI providers require Desktop. Core: 30 minutes. Optional page/data delegation: 8 minutes. You will verify one edit and one repair using run output. Checks are manual.

challenges.prompt: You want FlowPilot to explain one logger in a large board. What gives it a clear target?
challenges.explanation: The board assistant receives relevant selection and board context.

options.label: Select that node in the open board and ask for an explanation
Describe only its approximate screen position
Open an unrelated App first

challenges.prompt: Auto mode is enabled. Should you assume every completed board review waits for an Apply click?
challenges.explanation: Auto mode changes when tools and completed reviews apply. Existing-item deletions retain an explicit confirmation gate.

options.label: Yes; Auto affects only the chat response speed
Yes; compilation always requires manual approval
No; completed reviews can apply automatically

challenges.prompt: Which addition makes “improve this flow” reviewable?
challenges.explanation: A specific result and constraints make the proposed diff and run comparable with the request.

options.label: A request to change every node at once
A named target, one change, preserved behavior, and expected output
More adjectives about quality

lessons.title: Optional: coordinate a page and its data

challenges.prompt: A page preview renders, but Refresh has no workflow behind it. What remains?
challenges.explanation: UI generation and workflow behavior are separate artifacts that must be connected.

options.label: Build and bind the workflow, then test through the configured page
Change the page title
Treat the screenshot as an execution test

challenges.prompt: FlowPilot says the repair is complete. What closes this deterministic task?
challenges.explanation: The same failing input tests whether the repaired connection addresses the observed failure.

options.label: Accept its confidence as the result
Change the input before every comparison
Rerun the failing input and compare the actual message with the expected output

lessons.title: Make and verify a new edit

challenges.prompt: A teammate rewires the logger while your review is pending. What is the right next action?
challenges.explanation: A stale review no longer represents the current board. Review a proposal based on the actual state.

options.label: Assume the two edits cannot conflict
Regenerate or refresh the review against the current board
Force the old review onto the changed board

challenges.prompt: You request a live status page and only receive a component preview. Which result is still missing?
challenges.explanation: The interface must connect to behavior and be tested through its real entry point.

options.label: A connected data workflow and a tested Event invocation
A second copy of the same preview
A longer explanation of the layout
